scope: Supplementary human validation of fixed 30-example A-D subset; 120 matched outputs, two named human reviewers, seed42
method_origin: Quadratic weighted kappa, Spearman correlation, absolute-agreement ICC(A,1), and example-cluster bootstrap were specified in RQ3_human_validation.md before the joint analysis. Implementation was completed after submissions; a method auditor inspected point estimates before code finalization. No claim of preregistration or outcome-blind implementation is made.
selection: 10 per knowledge type from frozen40; metadata-only selection after original experiment and before human scoring; no selection based on human scores
score: Per output, mean of 25*(integer score-1) over applicable dimensions; use frozen knowledge applicability and instruction<=2 implies knowledge=1 rule
human_human_primary: Quadratically weighted Cohen kappa per 1-5 ordinal dimension; fixed support [1,2,3,4,5]
human_judge_primary: For each named human versus existing ChatGPT ratings, Spearman rho and ICC(A,1) on Q; same 120 outputs
icc_model: Two-way mixed effects, absolute agreement, single measurement; two named fixed raters per comparison; n=number of output targets (120), not 30
bootstrap_unit: Example UID: draw 30 examples with replacement, retaining all four conditions and all raters within each selected example; exclude non-applicable dimensions within each resample
interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of finite bootstrap statistics; report valid and invalid draw counts, never replace undefined statistics with zero or one
margin_interpretation: Reuse the original five-point tolerance as a supplementary sensitivity criterion on the 30-example human subset; retain the original 40-example judge results separately
secondary_descriptive: Mean signed second-minus-first Q difference and mean absolute difference
Condition means and paired effects for each human and matched original judge
Equal-weight mean of the two human Q scores, explicitly secondary, not adjudicated ground truth
Human-effect minus judge-effect paired differences on the same examples
Post-hoc largest human-judge disagreement cases; do not remove them or change original scores
missingness: Require complete scoreable submissions for this analysis; stop for explicit missing-data review if any item is unreadable rather than silently dropping it
encoding: Preserve original files. Accept case-only TRUE/FALSE changes in spreadsheet flags. Invalid UTF-8 is allowed only in optional ambiguity notes and rendered as explicit byte escapes in derived text; reject invalid bytes in IDs, scores or rationales.
exclusions: Four practice outputs per reviewer excluded; no E/F human ratings, no extra seeds, no claims about all40 effects or arbitrary future raters
